blocks.text: Seminiferous tubules se spermatozoa nalyon ke ek jaal (network) mein jate hain jise rete testis kehte hain. Yahan se woh ek lambi, bal khayi nali, epididymis, mein dakhil hote hain. Yahan tak spermatozoa harkat nahin kar sakte (non-motile). Woh kam az kam 18 ghante epididymis mein rehte hain, phir harkat ke qabil (motile) ho kar ek aur lambi nali, vas deferens, mein jate hain. Vas deferens inguinal canal ke raaste pait ke andar (abdominal cavity mein) jati hai.

blocks.title: For Information: testes bahar kyun hain
blocks.text: Nashonuma ke dauran testes pait ke andar bante hain. Paidaish se thora pehle woh ek surakh se neeche utar kar scrotum mein aa jate hain. Scrotum testes ko taqreeban 34°C par rakhta hai, jo jism ke andaruni temperature (37°C) se thora kam hai. Sperms ki nashonuma ke liye yahi kam temperature zaroori hai.

Har testis ki vas deferens ek seminal vesicle (ek gland) ki nali se mil jati hai. Milne ke baad is nali ko ejaculatory duct kehte hain. Dono testes se aane wali do ejaculatory ducts prostate gland ke andar se guzarti hain aur wahan urethra mein khulti hain; urethra urinary bladder (peshab ki thaili) se aati hai. Urethra penis ke zariye jism se bahar khulti hai.
